evidence_grades.source-verified: Claim is directly checked against repository source or a strict machine registry.
evidence_grades.test-verified: Claim is exercised by an automated passing test.
evidence_grades.recorded-local: A dated local run was observed and summarized, but raw external runner logs are not retained here.
evidence_grades.retained-artifact: Logs, digests, reports, or artifacts are retained at the referenced path.
evidence_grades.external-primary: Claim is supported by a linked primary or official external source.
evidence_grades.planned: The item is authorized work, not implementation evidence.
